scope: Sweep allocations reached by the raw OBJECTS writer overload that accepts an explicit owner override for a retained SUN carrier.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored ASCII DXF generated per target revision during the test
source.profile: One VPORT table row (*ACTIVE, source handle 0x721) references one SUN object (source handle 0x706); the typed and retained raw SUN records agree on owner 0x721. The test source is generated at runtime and removed; no fixture file is committed.

implementation.change: Added a focused allocation-failure test that imports a generated VPORT/SUN source, then emits the retained SUN through writeRawDxfObject(rawSun, ownerOverride). The normal output planner emits/remaps the VPORT owner before the direct raw-object callback.
implementation.method: Warm/calibrate the complete staged DXF export; inject std::bad_alloc at each allocation reached inside the raw SUN callback; require failed publication, byte-identical destination sentinel, unchanged caller raw object, same-adapter retry to calibration-identical bytes, and fresh typed import proving the remapped VPORT, SUN and raw-carrier owner edges agree.

validation.ascii: 5/5 reached callback allocation failures preserve destination and caller state; same-adapter retry and typed owner readback pass.

verificationRefresh.scope: Revalidated the current versioned writer test after observing that its implementation exercises Binary output although the original receipt recorded only ASCII.
verificationRefresh.directRun: PASS; AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032 each passed in ASCII and Binary. Every reached failure preserved the destination and caller SUN; same-adapter byte-identical retry and typed VPORT/SUN owner readback passed.

limitations: Generated transport and transaction evidence only; no physical producer prevalence or native SUN behavior is established.
The profile covers one generated rooted VPORT/SUN graph; other owner types, source producer profiles and native presentation remain unqualified.

planImpact.completedSlice: The raw SUN explicit-owner-override overload on one generated rooted VPORT/SUN graph across AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 and ASCII/Binary, including reached-allocation rollback, same-adapter byte-identical retry and typed owner readback.
